en: The image is of an old postcard featuring a sepia-toned photograph of a musical family, identified as 'Virtuosen-Familie Kräusel,' all in period dress with various musical instruments including a violin and guitar. The back of the postcard contains handwritten text addressed to Camille Melin in Boulogne sur Mer, France. There is a Swedish postage stamp and multiple postmarks, including ones from Boulogne and Vänersborgs Museum. The postcard text is in German and French. The postcard is marked with 'Weltpostverein Postkarte UNION POSTALE UNIVERSELLE,' indicating it was meant for international posting.
